merged: **Domaine des Trois Chênes – Handover Summary (≤150 words)** - **Vineyard:** 18 ha (11 ha Cabernet Franc, 7 ha Chenin Blanc) on clay‑flint soils. - **Production:** ~62 000 bottles/year; 2024 output fell to 48 000 after May hail **cut the western plots by a fifth (≈20 %)**. - **Organic:** certified 2019. **Biodynamic conversion** started 2023; certification expected earliest 2026. - **Exports:** 41 % of volume (main markets Belgium, Japan). Japan requires sulphites **< 60 mg/L**. - **Past issues:** * 2022 Tank 4 controller drift – €11 000 loss; controllers now calibrated pre‑harvest, a second probe installed. * 2023 label/mislabelling – 900 bottles recalled; proof‑signing now requires two signatures. - **Operational rules:** No irrigation on western plots; harvest dates set after three consecutive mornings of sugar + acidity readings; any tank >28 °C must be cooled within four hours. - **Pending items (uncertain):** Lighter‑weight bottles – importer interest unconfirmed, no cost
